blind.description: A freestanding ornate candelabra featuring a molded circular pedestal base with decorative detailing, a fluted vertical stem accented with decorative rings, and three candle arms aligned in a straight row at the top. Each arm terminates in a circular drip saucer and socket holding a short cream-coloured wax candle with a black wick. The body has a polished antique brass/gold metal finish with red-and-gold patterned accents on the base and mid-stem node. All surfaces are clean, smooth, and solid with no flames or emissive glow.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a concentric circular base overlaid by three smaller circular candle cups aligned in a single straight row.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 55% as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 3 ft 2 in tall), and about 1 ft to 1.2 ft wide at the base and candle arms.

notes: candle arms span slightly wider than catalog default ratio but fit floor candelabra design
